name: Fit Drums: Rhythm Workout

Ready to rock your fitness goals? Fit Drums transforms energetic drumming into an addictive full-body exercise. Follow the beats, strike the drums positioned in 8 dynamic directions, and sculpt your muscles while losing yourself in the music!
